news.headline: Nektar v. Eli Lilly: Final Pretrial Rulings and Jury Selection Clear the Way for September 8 Trial
news.summary: Judge James Donato resolved the parties' motions in limine on August 7 (splitting rulings between both sides) and held a jury excusal conference on September 2, keeping the long-delayed breach-of-contract trial over the terminated rezpegaldesleukin collaboration on track to open September 8 in San Francisco with a 45-minute opening statement per side. Nektar alleges Lilly used flawed math that understated efficacy (about 66% versus a true ~83%) and let a conflict with its own lebrikizumab undermine the program, costing milestone and royalty payments, while Lilly denies wrongdoing and blames a third-party CRO calculation error; a summary judgment motion by Lilly was denied in March 2026.

news.headline: Nektar's (NKTR) Billion-Dollar Balance Sheet Faces A Multi-Year Test
news.summary: The piece frames the bear case: $1.02 billion of cash funds a wait of roughly two years to mid-2028 AD data and into second-half 2029 for the 850-patient alopecia areata Phase 3, against full-year R&D guidance of $210-230 million and revenue capped near $45 million, mostly non-cash royalties. Short interest stands at about 19.9% of float and hedge fund holders fell from 56 to 50 quarter over quarter.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results of Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: The Lancet published the full 16-week induction dataset from the 393-patient REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b across 107 sites in 10 countries: mean EASI reduction of 61% on 24 ug/kg q2w versus 31% on placebo (p<0.0001), with EASI-75 at 42% versus 17%. Serious adverse events occurred in 2% of participants with no deaths and no signal for infections or conjunctivitis, the first peer-reviewed validation that selective Treg expansion produces clinically meaningful skin outcomes.

news.headline: JPMorgan Initiates Coverage on Nektar Therapeutics with Neutral Rating and $65 Price Target
news.summary: JPMorgan started NKTR at Neutral with a $65 target, roughly 14% below the prior close and the second cautious voice after Wedbush's $80. It sits far under a consensus 12-month target near $153, where the sell-side skews Buy and Piper Sandler is highest at $192.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million on June 30, 2026 versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025, helped by the $373.8 million April equity raise, extending runway into Q3 2028 and past the targeted mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout. Net loss was $40.6 million ($1.23 per share) against an operating loss of $42.3 million, revenue of $10.1 million just missed consensus, and management reaffirmed a Phase 3 alopecia areata start in early 2027, a ZENITH AD-3 start in September, and a first rezpegaldesleukin BLA in 2029.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar began randomizing patients in ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2, two 510-patient global registrational trials in biologic/JAK-naive patients aged 12 and older, part of a roughly 1,530-patient program across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. The design followed FDA end-of-Phase 2 meetings and EMA scientific advice, targeting initial topline data in mid-2028 and a BLA in 2029.

catalysts.label: Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury trial opens (San Francisco federal court)
catalysts.detail: Trial opens September 8, 2026 before an 8-person jury; motions in limine were resolved August 7 and a jury excusal conference was held September 2, so the case is on track to proceed as scheduled after being postponed once from October 2025 by the government shutdown. Nektar alleges Lilly mismanaged and manipulated rezpeg efficacy data during their terminated collaboration and seeks damages for lost milestone/royalty payments; Lilly denies wrongdoing. A verdict either direction is a binary, uncorrelated legal catalyst layered on top of the clinical story.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: The third roughly 510-patient Phase 3 study, enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor treatment experience, is guided to begin by the end of September 2026. It completes the registrational package for both U.S. and European filings and tests rezpeg in the harder-to-treat population that already failed Dupixent or a JAK. Confirmation of the start is the next concrete, dateable clinical milestone.

catalysts.label: Two oral presentations at EADV Congress 2026, Vienna
catalysts.detail: Nektar has two accepted oral presentations at the 35th EADV Congress: Thomas Bieber on durable and deepening improvements with monthly and quarterly dosing from the REZOLVE-AD maintenance part, and David Rosmarin on 52-week Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA results in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata. Maintenance durability at reduced dosing frequency is the main commercial differentiator versus Dupixent, so the dermatology community's reaction here matters more than the raw numbers.

catalysts.label: 24-week off-treatment alopecia areata data
catalysts.detail: Management guided on the Q2 call to present 24-week off-treatment data for alopecia areata in the fourth quarter of 2026, aimed at informing long-term maintenance dosing strategy ahead of the Phase 3 start. Durability off drug is a key differentiator versus chronic-dosing competitors like JAK inhibitors. Exact date and venue not yet named.

catalysts.label: First NKTR-0165 (TNFR2 agonist) preclinical data at a scientific conference
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to presenting preclinical data for NKTR-0165, its bivalent TNFR2 agonist antibody, at a scientific conference in the second half of 2026. It is the only pipeline asset behind rezpeg and is paired with a February 2026 research collaboration with UCSF and Dr. Stephen Hauser in multiple sclerosis. Venue and date are not yet named.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Third-party estimates cluster around early-to-mid November 2026 for the next quarterly report, which should update cash burn against full-year R&D guidance of $210-230 million, confirm the ZENITH AD-3 start, give first enrollment colour across all three AD studies, and address the outcome of the September 8 Eli Lilly jury trial. Nektar has not yet announced an official date.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata study start (~850 patients)
catalysts.detail: Management reaffirmed on the Q2 call that it will start a single registrational Phase 3 in severe alopecia areata in early 2027, sized at roughly 850 patients, based on the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept (28.2% mean SALT reduction on 24 ug/kg q2w versus 11.2% placebo at 36 weeks). Rezpeg already holds FDA Fast Track in this indication, and the readout is guided to the second half of 2029.

catalysts.label: 52-week off-treatment atopic dermatitis data
catalysts.detail: Management guided to present 52-week off-treatment data for atopic dermatitis in the first quarter of 2027, to further inform long-term maintenance dosing ahead of the ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout. This builds on earlier signals of roughly nine months of off-treatment durability seen in prior-phase data.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, the decisive binary event for the equity. Cash runway extends into Q3 2028, so the company reaches this readout without a further raise. A repeat of the 61%-vs-31% EASI delta at Phase 3 scale is what the ~$153 consensus target is discounting.

catalysts.label: First rezpegaldesleukin BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Nektar has publicly guided to a first BLA filing for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in 2029, following the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline. The program was designed with EMA scientific advice in parallel, so a European filing is intended off the same dataset.

pulse: Nektar enters the week of September 3 with its two-track story converging fast: the Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury trial over the pair's soured rezpeg collaboration opens September 8 in San Francisco after motions in limine were resolved August 7 and jury selection wrapped September 2, making this a genuinely binary, uncorrelated legal catalyst layered on top of the clinical program. Underlying fundamentals remain constructive: $1.02 billion of cash funds runway into Q3 2028 past the mid-2028 ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout, The Lancet's August 25 publication of the REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b data (61% vs 31% mean EASI reduction) gave the mechanism its first peer-reviewed validation, and ZENITH AD-3 is guided to start by month-end alongside two EADV Congress oral presentations September 30-October 3. Sentiment stays split and skeptical near-term: JPMorgan's August 21 Neutral initiation at $65 and Wedbush at $80 sit well below a consensus near $153 (Piper Sandler high at $192), short interest is around 20% of float, and the stock continues to digest a roughly two-year wait to real Phase 3 data alongside the now-imminent Lilly litigation overhang.
